desc: Kelly stands next to Ryan, presenting a ring with her hand outstretched, then throws it on the ground.
Ryan, in a light shirt and striped tie, stands by Kelly, in a yellow cardigan over a floral top, who touches his arm while he covers his eyes and scratches his head, stressed.

Michael and Jim walking out the entrance as a silver car is parked out front.
Jim and Michael riding in a car, Michael rubbing his eyes with his fingers while talking.
Jim is pounding and yelling at closed doors in a rush.
Jim is leaving the gas station by car in a rush.
A man in a navy blue jumpsuit stands outside the gas station.
Pam talks on the phone, smiling flirtatiously, tongue slightly poking out, eyebrows raised.

A shot of Michael in front of a gas station, gas pumps behind him and someone cleaning the window of his car.
Pam finds a white sheet of paper with a drawing on it on the office fridge.

Darryl stands in the office glass doorway holding his mug, calmly yelling something with his mouth open.

Michael looking around and standing by a busy road, a food stand with a man in the window behind him.

Michael walking around a poor area with homeless people, then hiding in an alley with dumpsters.
